name: release
purpose: Human-gated release evidence and publication approval; not a deployment workflow.
activation_prerequisites: Verify the O1 GitHub principal and record the result.
Verify the O2 private reporting route and record the result.
Configure a second independent human before an exception or security disposition that cannot be self-approved.
Read back the live environment after configuration and update verified-live.json with observed facts only.
out_of_scope: This contract does not authorize provider deployment, DNS changes, or managed-resource writes.
No release or provider workflow is introduced by this baseline.
